globalEvidence.surfaceIdentityContract: data-surface-id must equal surfaceId and final URL must equal the manifest route
globalEvidence.criticalEvidencePolicy: Every critical state, dialog and tab is captured at 390, 768 and 1440 unless one explicit exception is approved by UI, UX and Product Owner.

rules: A Real action is executable only when the matching productiveBinding.realActions entry exists.
A Demo action resolves through surfaceActionEffects and the typed fixture snapshot.
Parameterized routes are instantiated from scenario.routeParams before navigation.
Evidence passes only when final URL and data-surface-id both match the instantiated scenario.

fixtures.public-commerce-live: Anonymous visitor; twelve coherent products, active campaign, offers, categories and help content.
fixtures.anonymous-access: No session, no privileged data and a safe allowlisted return destination.
fixtures.customer-active: Authenticated customer with cart, two addresses, local-tab favorites and correlated orders/post-sale.
fixtures.customer-checkout: Authenticated customer with available items, valid address, stock reservation and selectable delivery/payment simulations.
fixtures.operator-active: Authenticated operator with authorized actions and the canonical operational ledger: twelve correlated orders, variant balances, movements, incidents/returns, listings, sync jobs, campaigns and alerts.
fixtures.operator-restricted: Authenticated operator with a restricted role set for access-denied and capability blocking.
fixtures.corrupt-or-unknown: Unknown wire states, incompatible snapshot and recoverable valid prior state.

operationalLedger.precedence: This ledger controls SC-SURF-20..23 data. SC-SURF-15 is visual/navigation evidence only; alternative state specimens are isolated.

orders.disclosure: Historical pickup does not enable current pickup.

modules.disclosure: No independent productive capability ID; navigation/information only.
Runtime state is not fixed by this fixture; Unknown blocks mutation until an authoritative positive configVersion is loaded.
No independent productive capability ID; informational link to product and variant administration.

deterministicFixture.disclosure: Isolated neutral profile-import specimen derived from the existing server schema; not current merchant content.

none.expectation: No state mutation; reload returns the fixture baseline.

url-context.expectation: Query, filters, sort and page survive round-trip/reload through the URL.

safe-intent.expectation: Allowlisted product/variant/quantity/destination survive identity and reload without carrying arbitrary URL authority.

browser-session.expectation: Current-tab state survives route navigation in the tab but makes no account-sync claim.

demo-snapshot.expectation: Successful command persists transactionally; reload decodes the same valid state. Failure preserves the previous valid snapshot and emits no success.

server-authoritative.expectation: Real target reloads through the declared productiveBinding and renders the authoritative server response.

Real.unavailableAlternative: Omit fields and export/bulk controls absent from AdminOrder; explain no supported action.
Read-only explanation for payment, incident, fiscal, label, refund and partial/damaged-return capabilities not present in ports.
Read-only available/reserved/safety view; no adjustment, reconciliation, condition or physical balance controls.
Show Integration not available for OAuth, provider mutation, sync/activity and competition rather than rendering executable controls.
Operator reads only; future modules without productive IDs show availability and delivery information without a change control.
General settings, export and reset are omitted because the productive port supports only profile preview and selected home-section merge.

scenarioExpansion.rule: Each baseline scenario expands into independent Demo and Real cases, but states/dialogs/tabs/actions come from targetApplicability when present; prohibited target capabilities are excluded and the declared unavailableAlternative is evidenced instead. Other surfaces expand every declared state/dialog/tab and all global viewports. Checkout cases also expand by matrix scenario and applicable outcome. Critical states cannot be sampled away.
scenarioExpansion.collisionPolicy: Reject the expanded manifest before capture when two evidence records share the uniqueness key.
